label: Levels from fanout
subgoals: Bound the sinks reachable by L levels by F to the power L
Take the ceiling of the logarithm of the sink count
Check the bound with the neighbouring powers

label: Counting buffers
subgoals: Divide the sink count by the fanout and round up
Repeat on each level's count until one buffer remains
Sum the counts over all levels

label: The fanout that minimises latency
subgoals: Write latency as levels times stage delay
Evaluate it for each candidate fanout
Pick the fanout with the smallest latency
